$schema_note: BRANCH-ACCURATE implementation source. Occurrence is expressed as OR-of-AND rule branches: a species occurs where at least one complete branch is satisfied. Predicates inside a branch are correlated and must be evaluated together. Species-wide unions of restrictive fields are NOT used, because unioning correlated predicates invents combinations no source rule allows. These are community-derived empirical occurrence mechanics, NOT Frontier-published spawn rules. A match means candidate, never confirmed presence. Observed journal and DSS biology always outranks anything in this file.

revision.change_summary: Flattened species-wide predicate unions replaced with the correlated rule branches the maintained source actually carries. Four previously UNKNOWN body-type records resolved. One documented counterexample encoded as a falsified predicate.

predicate_state_vocabulary.UNKNOWN: The evidence does not establish whether this field constrains occurrence on this branch. Not a known requirement, so it never gates a match, and it is never treated as satisfied either. A branch carrying an UNKNOWN on a dimension this machine cannot observe is undecidable, never a match.
predicate_state_vocabulary.UNRESTRICTED: Evidence affirmatively establishes no meaningful restriction on this dimension for this branch. Used for body class only where the maintained rule carries no body-class predicate AND an independent observational dataset records the species across three or more body classes. Source omission alone is never read as UNRESTRICTED.
predicate_state_vocabulary.NOT_APPLICABLE: The predicate dimension does not meaningfully apply.
predicate_state_vocabulary._rule: These three states are the only permitted sentinels. null, an empty array and a missing key are never used to express them.
predicate_state_vocabulary._numeric_bounds: Every numeric bound is an object with min and max. Either end may be the string UNKNOWN, meaning that end is open rather than zero.

branch_semantics.species_match: At least one branch returns MATCH.
branch_semantics.species_no_match: Every branch has at least one definitively failed predicate.
branch_semantics.species_indeterminate: No branch matches, and at least one branch remains possible because a required fact or the rule itself is unavailable.
branch_semantics._why: Unioning body class, atmosphere, gravity and pressure across branches admits combinations no branch allows. Helium+Icy and Methane+Rocky are both real branches for one species; Helium+Rocky is a product of the flattening, not of any source rule.

empirical_envelope_policy: observed_envelope_reference and any empirical_lower_envelope value record what has been OBSERVED. They are not spawn limits. A maximum observed value is not a maximum allowed value, and a body class absent from an observation set is not a body class the species is excluded from. Observed envelopes never widen or narrow a rule on their own; they are context for review.
falsification_policy: A confirmed ScanOrganic observation proves the species was present under the recorded conditions. Where such an observation contradicts a rule predicate, the canonical value is preserved under the branch falsified[] block for provenance and the operative value is degraded to UNKNOWN. One observation falsifies a bound; it does not establish the replacement bound. This file records only counterexamples documented in tracked evidence. Contradictions found in local Commander telemetry are handled at runtime by the Exobiology Rule Sentinel, which never edits this file.

units.gravity_g: multiples of Earth surface gravity. The journal SurfaceGravity field is m/s^2 and MUST be divided before comparison: OmniCOVAS uses 9.80665, the upstream source uses 9.797759, a 0.09% difference that is immaterial at the precision these rules carry. Treating the raw journal figure as g overstates gravity by a factor of about ten.
units.atmosphere_pressure_atm: atmospheres (1 atm = 101325 Pa); OmniCOVAS's journal ingestion would need a Pa->atm or Pa->bar conversion, not currently present anywhere in omnicovas/
units.sample_distance_m: metres, minimum required separation between sample colonies (Colonial Range)
units.base_value_credits: Vista Genomics first-sale base value; NOT first-discovery or first-logged bonus; out of scope beyond what sources exposed incidentally
units.distance_from_arrival_ls: light seconds from the system arrival point, matching the journal's DistanceFromArrivalLS field which OmniCOVAS already ingests
units.atmosphere_component_min_pct: percent of atmosphere by the journal AtmosphereComposition Percent field

known_counterexamples.units_note: The journal SurfaceGravity field is m/s^2, NOT Earth-g. The upstream report compared the raw 0.584797 against a rule expressed in g. Converted correctly the body is 0.0596 g, which still exceeds the 0.055 g bound, so the falsification stands - but the empirical envelope is >= 0.0596 g, roughly a tenth of the raw figure. Confirmed three ways: BioScan divides the field by 9.797759, OmniCOVAS by 9.80665, and Newtons law on the body own MassEM (0.000267) and Radius (426743.625 m) returns 0.5844 m/s^2.
known_counterexamples.upstream_disposition: Maintainer acknowledged 2026-02-16 and said the bound needed cross-checking; osseus.py is byte-identical between the pinned v2.12.2 revision and master HEAD 5f0d2e44, so no corrected bound exists upstream.

species.notes: SPARSE-DATA / LOCATION-CONSTRAINED — do NOT generalize galaxy-wide. Single system, single species, permit-gated. Canonn itself flags gaps: seed-dispersal mechanism and pod-activation trigger remain undocumented despite in-game codex claims about them. Gravity range (0.05-0.38G) is the single strongest available falsification of any universal low-gravity exobiology assumption, but because it's drawn from one system it should be read as 'this organism tolerates unusually high gravity for exobiology,' not as evidence about gravity limits for the classic Odyssey genera. Community goal pricing (952,296 Cr per sample, 3311-11-13 to 3311-11-27) and seed sale price (250,000 Cr each) are time-boxed historical CG figures, not standing Vista Genomics base value — base_value_credits above is the standing Vista Genomics figure only. STOP CONDITION APPLIED per task instructions: evidence is insufficient for a generalized galaxy-wide prediction rule; this record should be surfaced by OmniCOVAS (if ever implemented) as an informational, location-gated entry only, never as a candidate-matching rule applied elsewhere in the galaxy.

disagreement_register_addendum._note: EXOBIOLOGY_DISAGREEMENT_REGISTER.md is preserved evidence and is not modified. These entries extend it and are authoritative for this revised dataset.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-04: REOPENED and resolved to a restriction (was: resolved to absent). Clypeus Speculumi carries a species-specific distance-from-arrival gate corroborated by DSN (> 2500 Ls, species named explicitly) and EDMC-BioScan (2000 on all three Speculumi variants, on no other Clypeus species). Canonn is silent. The lower threshold is operative. See D-12 for the open unit question.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-06: RESOLVED. The Fungoida rule source was retrieved at the pinned revision during repair verification; the access gap that made all four Fungoida records single-source no longer exists. Superseded by D-09, D-10 and D-11.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-08: Electricae Radialem gravity ceiling: EDMC-BioScan 0.276 (rule ceiling, adopted) vs Canonn 0.27 (observed sample maximum). Unresolved but bounded; the difference is 0.006 g.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-09: Fungoida Gelata galactic region: Canonn states No Preference (adopted as operative); EDMC-BioScan excludes one core region on all six rule variants. Unresolved. OmniCOVAS cannot evaluate galactic region locally, so this disagreement has no runtime effect today.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-10: Gravity-ceiling precision cluster. Nine records carry 0.28 from Canonn where EDMC-BioScan's rule ceiling is 0.276. Canonn renders gravity at two decimal places, so 0.28 is consistent with 0.276 rather than contradicting it. Values verified per species and retained; disclosed rather than silently normalised. Electricae Radialem is excluded from this cluster — its 0.28 was supported by neither source and was repaired under F-3a.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-11: Fungoida Bullarum body types: Canonn documents Rocky Ice only; EDMC-BioScan admits rocky, rocky ice and high metal content. Unresolved. The narrower Canonn list is operative because it cannot produce a false candidate.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-12: Unit of the EDMC-BioScan distance field for Clypeus Speculumi is not annotated in the source. DSN's comparable claim is stated in Ls and the field is consumed against an arrival-distance value, so Ls is inferred. Flagged rather than asserted.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-13: Fungoida Bullarum, Gelata and Stabitis body class. The maintained rule permits more body classes than Canonn has observed (Bullarum: rule allows Rocky/Rocky ice/HMC, Canonn observes Rocky ice 100%). The rule is operative and the Canonn distribution is recorded as an observed envelope, because absence from an observation set does not establish exclusion. The previous dataset had encoded the Canonn envelope as the rule, which produced false exclusions.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-14: Bacterium Bullaris body class. The Methane branch carries no body-class predicate and Canonn observes Icy at 94%. The previous flattened record listed Rocky and HMC only, which excluded the single most commonly observed body class for this species.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-15: Radicoida Unica naming and body class. The maintained source names the species Unicus and gates only on system HIP 87621; Canonn and INARA logbooks name it Unica. The display name follows Canonn/INARA as before. The body-class list carried by the previous dataset is not supported by either the maintained rule or a sample large enough to establish UNRESTRICTED, so body class is now UNKNOWN and the species remains location-gated.
disagreement_register_addendum.D-16: Osseus Discus Water branch maximum gravity. Falsified by a documented Commander observation; see EXOBIOLOGY_KNOWN_COUNTEREXAMPLES.md CX-001. Upstream issue #50 is open and the source is unchanged, so no corrected bound exists to adopt.
